description: Agent-native CLI for managing ECS instances without public IPs, primarily for single-instance operations. It supports millisecond-level remote command execution, large file transfers up to 1GB, and TCP port forwarding. It offers four authentication modes: AK, RamRoleArn, CredentialsCmd, and CredentialsURI. Use it to run commands, deploy code, view logs, check processes, transfer files, set up port forwarding, or query and filter ECS instance lists.
